MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The J-B Weld epoxy felt somewhat relevant because it could help repair hardware, although I would wait for a specific repair before buying it.",
    "Some recommendations recognized my interest in practical hardware supplies, but that connection alone did not make them things I need now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "My hooks, washers, and metric bolts relate to mounting and organizing; cutting wheels, rust-removal brushes, and pocket-hole screws serve different tasks I have not shown a need for.",
    "Small screws do not imply that I am doing electrical wiring, and neither the COVID test nor the reacher connects to my current hardware interests.",
    "Four rolls of sealing tape and ten containers of glue feel excessive for my occasional use, especially without an immediate repair."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations treated workshop and repair supplies as broadly interchangeable, even though the particular job matters to me.",
    "My purchases of hardware assortments seemed to be taken as interest in other specialized kits and bulk supplies, regardless of whether I need their contents."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases repeatedly involved magnetic hooks and fastening hardware, which points more specifically toward mounting and organizing needs.",
    "I rarely buy without a concrete use in mind; a potentially useful repair product is not enough to make me act now.",
    "Supplies that require a particular tool or technique are only relevant if I actually have that equipment and task."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized a broad hardware interest but missed my narrower mounting and organizing needs and my reluctance to buy without a specific task."
}
